FN-XF6W7Z-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 162
Committee: Finance and Taxation General Fund Sponsor: Senator Tom Butler
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 04/18/2023
Senate Bill 162 as introduced would increase the financial obligations of the Board of
Veterinary Medical Examiners by a maximum of $3,200 per meeting of the board to increase
the daily stipend from $200 per day to $600 per day.

FN-XF6W7Z-2
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 162
Committee: Ways and Means General Fund Sponsor: Senator Tom Butler
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 05/08/2023
Senate Bill 162 as passed the Senate would increase the financial obligations of the Board of
Veterinary Medical Examiners by a maximum of $1,600 per meeting of the board by increasing
the daily stipend for board members from $200 per day, currently, to $400 per day.
